scenarios.name: no-jace-token-creates-one-with-eight-loyalty
scenarios.why: Empower Jace 8 with no Jace token: first a blue Jace planeswalker token is created, then eight loyalty counters go on it. The runner locates tokens by printed face name (the token's CR 111.4 name is 'Jace Token'), so the ref is p0:token:Token; the Jace subtype is asserted separately.

scenarios.name: existing-jace-token-gets-eight-more
scenarios.why: Cast a second time while its controller already controls a Jace token: no new token is created, the existing one gets eight more loyalty counters (8 + 8 = 16).

scenarios.name: loyalty-ability-on-opponents-turn-once
scenarios.why: Cast in the opponent's upkeep (it is an instant), it creates the Jace token and lets its controller activate that Jace's loyalty abilities on any player's turn at instant speed: the [-3] draws a card in the opponent's upkeep (loyalty 8 -> 5). The permission changes only timing, not CR 606.3's one-loyalty-ability-per-permanent-per-turn limit, so the [-1] is then not offered.

scenarios.name: permission-ends-with-the-turn
scenarios.why: Cast in its controller's own first main phase, the 'until end of turn' permission is gone by the opponent's next upkeep: with priority there, the Jace token's loyalty abilities are not offered (normal CR 606.3 timing applies again).
